command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
cases = [
    ('direct eval', 'eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 'src/example.py', 1),
    ('nested eval', 'def run():\\n    return eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 'src/nested/example.py', 1),
    ('multiline eval', 'eval\\n# mention only\\nresult = eval(\\n    \"1 + 1\"\\n)\\n', 'src/example.py', 1),
    ('comment', '# eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 'src/example.py', 0),
    ('strings', 'text = \\'eval(\"1 + 1\")\\'\\ndoc = \"\"\"eval(\\'1 + 1\\')\"\"\"\\n', 'src/example.py', 0),
    ('method', 'obj.eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 'src/example.py', 0),
    ('other builtin', 'len([1, 2])\\n', 'src/example.py', 0),
    ('outside src', 'eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 'example.py', 0),
]
for name, source, relative_path, expected in cases:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eval-check-') as directory:
        work = pathlib.Path(directory)
        for filename in ('check.py', 'checks.json'):
            shutil.copy2(root / filename, work / filename)
        (work / 'src').mkdir()
        fixture = work / relative_path
        fixture.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fixture.write_text(source)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'check.py'], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (name, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        assert result.stdout.strip() == (relative_path if expected else ''), (name, result.stdout)
        assert not result.stderr, (name, result.stderr)
        print(f'PASS: {name}')
PY"
